1 · Intro

When to use it.

Exempt (monthly) employees' time off is managed in Oracle, not UKG. You review it, approve or chase approval, and enter it on someone's behalf when needed.

Oracle gives you three quick actions for this: Add Absence, Existing Absences, and Absence Balance.

Use this whenYou need to review, approve, enter, or correct time off for an exempt employee.

  • Open item: which quick actions HCMs see under Our Workforce, and whether HCMs approve exempt time off or only managers do, must be confirmed on screen.

HCM Academy job aid · Leave Management

Managing Exempt Time Off in Oracle

Use when: You need to review, approve, enter, or correct time off for an exempt employee. · System: Oracle Absence Management

  1. Go to Our Workforce > Quick Actions (Show More) and find the absence quick actions.
  2. Check the balance with Absence Balance before you approve or enter time.
  3. Review what is already recorded in Existing Absences.
  4. Approve requests from the notifications bell.
  5. Enter time off for someone with Add Absence when needed.
  6. Correct mistakes in Existing Absences: edit or withdraw, don't double-enter.
  7. Finish before the exempt payroll cutoff.

Watch-outs

  • Exempt time off belongs in Oracle; non-exempt time off belongs in UKG. Check exempt status before you enter anything.
  • Open item: which quick actions HCMs see under Our Workforce, and whether HCMs approve exempt time off or only managers do, must be confirmed on screen.
  • Open item: Vanderbilt's leave process is pending review by Sheila, the Leave SME.
